name: operator-kit
description: operator-kit: run a product team as a human-in-the-loop multi-agent workflow on Claude Code. This marketplace ships both sides: the operator plugin (decides, specs, dispatches, monitors) and the operator-worker plugin (picks up dispatched issues and drives them to merged PRs).

plugins.name: operator
plugins.description: The operator side of operator-kit: skills that turn strategy into specs and dispatched GitHub issues (cycle, design, spec, dispatch, monitor, retro, status, opportunities), a session-start hook with live state, the verify gate, and /operator:init which scaffolds a host repo with CONFIG.md, docs/, lessons, references and the scripts/operator launcher.

plugins.name: operator-worker
plugins.description: Downstream worker side of the operator-kit dispatch pipeline: the working-agent-tasks + raising-issues skills and /work-queue command that pick up operator-dispatched `agent-task` GitHub issues and drive them to merged, closed-out PRs via the shared label/PR contract — attended or autonomous, using each repo's own development methodology.
